selections.justification:
Private VLAN does not work on 534, related to CR30322.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that private VLANs operate correctly. The test transmits traffic between promiscuous, isolated, and community ports and confirms that primary-to-secondary and secondary-to-primary traffic flows while traffic between isolated and community ports is blocked.

selections.title: CR-64796 - IPv6 Router Solicitation can not be sent when firewall is enabled after AW+ router is rebooted
selections.justification:
CR-64796 - IPv6 Router Solicitation can not be sent when firewall is enabled after AW+ router is rebooted

[Log-derived analysis] Regression test that IPv6 Router Solicitations are still sent after reboot when the firewall is enabled, guarding against a firewall-related defect that suppressed them.

selections.title: Specifying a range of ports that do not exist will cause a coredump
selections.justification:
Specifying a range of ports that do not exist will cause a coredump

[Log-derived analysis] Regression test that configuring a non-existent port range does not cause a coredump, confirming graceful handling of invalid port-range input.

step4.objective:
• DHCPv6 server address-range configuration is accepted and applied when the configured range falls within the prefix bound to the serving interface.
  • Address leases issued to requesting clients fall strictly within the configured range boundaries, with no overlap or out-of-range allocation.
  • DNS-server option configuration is rejected or flagged when applied to an interface that has no assigned IPv6 address.
  • Configuration of an address range that is invalid, reversed, or exceeds the available prefix space is rejected with an appropriate error indication.
  • DHCPv6 client receiving an address lease does not install a default route as a side effect of the assigned range.
  • IPv6 DNS server information distributed via DHCPv6 is correctly stored and retrievable on the receiving device.
  • Previously leased addresses are reclaimed and returned to the available pool on lease expiry or release, remaining consistent with the configured range.
  • Current DHCPv6 server address-range configuration and active lease bindings are visible and correctly reported via device status/show output.
  • Boundary conditions at the edges of the configured address range (first and last usable addresses) are allocated and reported correctly.
